description: Agent Mining Records: submit the mine’s own safety records with the corrective actions, completions and blasting log they answer to: the reading moment; each incident entry with its id, reference, the moment it occurred, the location and the persons it names; each corrective action with its id, reference, the incident and the moment it is due; each completion entry with its id, reference, the corrective action and the moment completed; each blasting log entry with its id, reference, the blaster, the location, what the log records beyond the planned blast (none, misfire, flyrock or other) and the moment fired. The signed report gives the incidents and the records behind them, each incident against a corrective action, each corrective action due against a completion entry, each blasting log event against an incident entry for its day and location, and each incident entry for its date, location and persons, and counts them, and names divergent mine safety records: an incident entry with no corrective action behind it, a corrective action past its due date with no completion entry, a blasting log entry recording a misfire, flyrock or other event with no incident entry behind it, and an incident entry missing the date, the location or the persons; then a corrective action naming an incident the record does not hold and a blasting log entry naming no blaster, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No incident or blasting log entries, or no corrective actions beside incidents, leaves those points unverified. Incidents, actions, blasts and entries match by letters and digits, locations by their words with plurals folded, dates by the day, and an action due after the reading moment waits. This reads the mine safety record, with blasting log entries read as part of it. Verdict mine_safety_record_divergent, mine_safety_record_partial, mine_safety_record_unverified or mine_safety_record_consistent. POST /api/mining-safety-record-check. Reads the mining records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no mine, contacts no regulator, land office or other operator and issues no permit, claim or certification, which stay with the mine operator, the land office and the regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Mining Records reads mineral extraction records (hard-rock, coal, aggregate and quarry operations), not cryptocurrency mining and not data mining; the Agent Datasets family reads data sets. It reads a mine operator’s own records: mine records with operator licensing and certification entries, mining claim records for mineral land, mine permit records as issued, mine inspection records with citations and abatements, mine safety records with the blasting log, mining production records by period, the mine’s own tailings facility records and reclamation records with their bond entries, each against the permit, claim, production, certification, schedule, corrective action, shipment, capacity, closure and bond records it answers to. The family’s ground is the mine’s paper trail: what the mine record claims, whether the claims, permits and inspections hold up, what the safety and production records support, and whether the tailings and reclamation records line up; it reads by record holder and subject: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production and land records, the Agent Waste and Recycling Records family reads manifested waste and disposal records, wever_water-discharge-record-check reads mine effluent monitoring, and the Agent Claims family reads insurance claims, while this family reads the mine’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-mining-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-mining-records/.
